name: simple blast
role: The shared blast component (Blast spell, destroyed building/boat land explosion, Earthquake's fissure trigger, etc.) - radius/push constants read from the instance's own fields. Side effect: can push a hit PERSON into its OWN separate state 26 (class 1, a different state space) - see person_states.tsv.

name: smoke
role: Named only via the per-component state list in the Unit record reference; own per-turn body not independently traced this investigation.

name: burn cell
role: Named only via the per-component state list; a damaged-ground/fire cell effect, own per-turn body not independently traced.

name: ember / particle trail
role: Entered by the type-0xA init: snaps to ground height, sets drawable to hfx 1120 draw class 29 (the same bright projectile sprite fireball shots and the firewarrior's bolt use), 4-turn life. Left behind every turn of flight (fireball shots) and while a blast-scorched/burning PERSON's own trailing-effect counter is still >8 (a class-1, not class-7, mechanism - see person_states.tsv state 26).

name: ghost army
role: Named only via the per-component state list; Ghost army spell's own units. Own per-turn body not independently traced.

name: invisibility
role: Named only via the per-component state list; own per-turn body not independently traced (the invisibility STATUS on a person is a separate class-1 flag, +0x10 bit 0x1000, not this effect state).

name: earthquake
role: Named only via the per-component state list. A related but state-unconfirmed function, process_explode_building (0x50D9A0), is the per-turn body of the earthquake's own spawned class-7 type-0x1A (26) sub-effect - not confirmed to be this same state number, flagged open.

name: volcano
role: Named only via the per-component state list; the volcano controller itself. See 'Volcano rocks'/'Volcano fireballs'/'Volcano lava flow' for its spawned sub-effects' own, separately-numbered states (9, 33, 38, 51).

name: hypnotism
role: Named only via the per-component state list; own per-turn body not independently traced (the hypnotised STATUS on a person is a separate class-1 flag/timer, not this effect state).

name: lightning bolt
role: Named only via the per-component state list; the bolt's own flight/strike effect - distinct from process_lightning_bolt (0x511F70), which sets the STRUCK PERSON into their own separate class-1 state 44 (see person_states.tsv), not this state.

name: swamp
role: Named only via the per-component state list; distinct from process_swamp (0x511400), which can set a drowning/stuck PERSON into their own separate class-1 state 27 (see person_states.tsv).

name: angel of death (meteor/spawn)
role: Named only via the per-component state list; the falling-meteor/spawn visual, distinct from the angel's own ongoing hunting AI, which is class-1 PERSON state 28 (see person_states.tsv) once the angel itself exists as a person.

name: whirlwind
role: The tornado's own per-turn body: counts down an active 'scan and damage' phase then a drifting/fading phase; re-walks a chain of effect objects for its progressive water/land colour change; while active, scans its own cell and acts on whatever it finds (persons -> their own class-1 state 24, buildings -> wood pull or destruction, scenery -> wood loss, vehicles -> a state-1 simple blast). See 'Whirlwind mechanics'.

name: insect plague (swarm)
role: The invisible cloud's own per-turn body: sound, home-leash steering, and gated bee-dot spawning (0x510D40, its own class-7 type 0x1B, a ~19-step sub-state cycle of its own at 0x510CB0 once it has a held reference unit). See 'Insect plague'.

name: firestorm
role: Firestorm's own per-turn body: gated fireball spawn. See 'Firestorm fireballs'.

name: erosion
role: Runs one hydraulic-erosion pass per turn via 0x4983A0 over a jittered window. See 'Erosion passes'.

name: land bridge
role: Per-cell smoke, height step, refresh and neighbour notification - handler addresses known from the Reference table, body not re-derived in this investigation.

name: lightning
role: Named only via the per-component state list; distinct from process_lightning_bolt's victim-side effect (class-1 state 44) and from effect state 18 ('lightning bolt') - not reconciled which of 18/30 is the bolt's flight vs. the strike/flash itself.

name: flatten
role: Named only via the per-component state list; the Flatten spell's own levelling effect. Own per-turn body not independently traced.

name: lava flow
role: Downhill spread, then fade, then ash. See 'Volcano lava flow'. Type 0x40's own effect (state 51, below) is spawned both deterministically by the volcano controller and probabilistically by this spread.

name: lava square
role: A single, non-spreading damaged-ground/fire cell (blend decays, self-destructs once low, keeps the ground on fire while blend is high) - used e.g. by Earthquake's fissure. See 'Volcano lava flow'.

name: (unnamed, type 0x40)
role: Entered directly by the type-0x40 init. Spawned deterministically by the volcano controller (cast turns 120-240) and probabilistically (~1/128 per hot cell per turn) by lava flow's own spread (state 33). Role beyond entry untraced - possibly a small ember/spark.

name: convert wild
role: Named only via the per-component state list; the Convert spell's own per-turn body (every 8 turns, nearest wildman within 2 cells -> brave) is documented behaviourally in 'Spells' but not tied to this state number by address.

name: shield
role: Named only via the per-component state list; the magical-shield STATUS on a person is a separate class-1 flag (+0x14 bit 0x8000), not this effect state, which is presumably the caster-side visual/aura component.

name: armageddon
role: Named only via the per-component state list; own per-turn body not independently traced.

name: bloodlust
role: Named only via the per-component state list; the bloodlust STATUS on a person is a separate class-1 flag/timer (+0x14 bit 0x80000), not this effect state.

name: teleport
role: Named only via the per-component state list; own per-turn body not independently traced.
